note: Player talk lines (js/state/squadMood.js, shown in the player profile window). Placeholders: {name} player name, {role} squad status (key player, first team, rotation, backup, prospect), {team} team name

happy: I'm loving my football here. I want things to carry on just like this.
I'm feeling sharp at the moment and I'm happy with my minutes.
You've given me real confidence, boss. There's more to come from me.
Nothing in particular to report. I'll just keep doing what I'm doing.
The mood in the camp is great. I want to pull my weight too.
ok: It's not bad. I'd just like to be playing a bit more.
When the chance comes, I'm ready to take it.
I understand my status here — {role}. Still, I do worry about my match sharpness.
I'm confident in training. I just need time on the pitch to show it.
I'm fine for now. I'm waiting to see how things go.
unhappy: Boss, to be honest, I'm barely playing at the moment.
I was told my status was {role}, but all I do is sit on the bench. It's frustrating.
I'd like to hear why I keep getting left out of the starting eleven.
I'm worried my career is going to stall if this carries on.
Even my family keep asking why I'm not playing. I don't know what to tell them.
I'm giving everything in training, but I never get the chance to prove it in a match.
request: Boss, I can't go on like this. I want to leave.
I've spoken to my agent. I'd like you to let me look at other clubs.
I don't think there's a place for me here. I want a transfer.
I've made up my mind. I want to go somewhere I'll play.
I love this club, but right now I think leaving is the right thing.

promise: That's a promise, right? I'll trust you. I won't let you down.
That's all I needed to hear. I'll repay you on the pitch.
Good. Just make sure I get my chance this time.
Thanks. I'll prove myself in the next few games.
Understood. I'll be remembering that promise.
competeAccept: Fair enough. I'll show you more in training.
Understood. I'll win my place myself.
I accept that. There are still parts of my game to work on. I'll keep grafting.
Fine by me. If it's a fight for a place, I fancy my chances.
I'll be ready for when the chance comes.
competeHurt: I still have to prove myself? That stings a bit.
So what I've shown so far isn't enough, then.
Understood. But I see it differently.
…If that's how you see it, I've got nothing to say.
I thought I'd already won the battle for a starting spot.
reassure: I'll wait. Just not for too long.
I'll take you at your word.
Understood. I'll get my head right and be ready.
Thanks. I feel a bit better about it now.
Still, I can't help wanting to be out there playing.
allowTransfer: Thanks for understanding. I'll stay professional until the day I leave.
Thank you, boss. I'll find myself a good club.
It can't have been an easy decision. I appreciate it.
I'll keep giving my all for the time I've got left here.
I hope our paths cross again one day.
cooldown: We only spoke the other day. I'll wait and see for now.
Nothing's changed since our last chat.
promised: You've already given me your word. Just keep an eye on it.

unhappy: {name} has made his unhappiness with his playing time known.
{name} is looking downcast. A chat might be needed.
request: {name}'s camp have made it known that he wants to leave.
promiseKept: {name}: Thank you for keeping your word.
{name} is pleased to be getting the playing time he was promised.
promiseBroken: {name}: You broke your promise. I'm disappointed.
